info.title: Vtiger CRM Webservices API
info.description: OpenAPI description of the Vtiger CRM Webservices (RPC) API: every /webservice.php operation vtigercrm 8.4.0 registers (core: getchallenge, login, logout, extendsession, listtypes, describe, relatedtypes, create, retrieve, update, revise, delete, retrieve_inventory, convertlead, query, sync, retrieve_related, query_related, add_related, files_retrieve, changePassword, deleteUser; the bundled Mobile module's eleven mobile.* operations) plus lookup from the Vtiger Cloud manual, not just the ones the OpenFn `@openfn/language-vtiger` adaptor calls by name. The real API is RPC-style: every call is issued against the single /webservice.php endpoint and the action is selected via an `operation` parameter (form-encoded for POST, query string for GET). To make the surface mockable, each RPC operation is modelled here as a distinct path segment under /webservice.php. Every response is wrapped in the standard envelope { "success": boolean, "result": ... } (or { "success": false, "error": {...} } on failure). The adaptor authenticates with a getchallenge -> login handshake (accessKey = md5(token + accessKey)) and drives records through a generic `postElement({ operation, elementType, element })` helper that maps onto create/update/delete/revise; it has no generic path builder, so only this bounded RPC surface is reachable through it (the newer Basic-Auth REST API at /restapi/v1/vtiger/default, which adds a couple of endpoints like get_account_hierarchy with no webservice.php equivalent, is architecturally unreachable and out of scope).

servers.description: Vtiger On-Demand / self-hosted CRM instance host. The adaptor appends `/webservice.php` to the configured hostUrl.

instance.description: Vtiger instance / subdomain (self-hosted installs use their own host).

get.description: First step of the login handshake. Returns a short-lived challenge token that must be combined with the user's access key (md5(token + accessKey)) to produce the login accessKey.

post.summary: Log in and open a session
post.description: Second step of the handshake. Exchanges the username and computed accessKey (md5(challengeToken + userAccessKey)) for a session.
Destroys the session. Vtiger registers logout as a POST operation and vtws_logout() rejects any other request method with OPERATION_NOT_SUPPORTED, so the session id goes in the form body.
Returns the CRM modules the authenticated user can access, along with per-module metadata. Called by the adaptor's `listTypes()` operation.

get.summary: List accessible module types, optionally filtered by field type
get.description: listtypes is registered as a GET operation, so its one parameter, fieldTypeList, is read from the query string only. The adaptor's listTypes() POSTs instead (see the post operation), which works because the operation name and sessionName are read from $_REQUEST and fieldTypeList is optional.

parameters.name: fieldTypeList
parameters.description: JSON-encoded array of field types (e.g. ["email"]); restricts the result to modules having a field of one of those types.

get.summary: Describe a module's fields and metadata

parameters.name: elementType
parameters.description: Module name to describe, e.g. Contacts, Accounts, Leads.

post.description: Creates a record in the given module. Reached via the adaptor's `postElement({ operation: 'create', elementType, element })`.

get.summary: Retrieve a CRM record by id

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Webservice record id, e.g. "12x45" (moduleId x recordId).

post.description: Replaces a record with the supplied element. Reached via `postElement({ operation: 'update', ... })`.
Updates only the supplied fields of a record (partial update). Reached via `postElement({ operation: 'revise', ... })`.
Deletes a record by id. Reached via `postElement({ operation: 'delete', ... })`.

get.description: Executes a read-only, SQL-like query (VtigerQL). Query strings must end with a semicolon.

parameters.name: query
parameters.example: SELECT * FROM Contacts WHERE lastname = 'Smith' LIMIT 0,10;
parameters.description: VtigerQL statement terminated by a semicolon.

get.summary: Fetch records changed since a timestamp

parameters.name: modifiedTime
parameters.description: Unix epoch seconds; records modified at or after this time are returned.

parameters.name: elementType
parameters.description: Optional module name to restrict the sync to.

get.summary: Search records by phone or email across modules
get.description: Searches for records whose phone or email field matches a value, across one or more modules/fields. Documented as a webservice.php operation alongside the newer REST endpoint of the same name.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Which kind of value to search for.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The phone number or email address to search for.

parameters.name: searchIn
parameters.description: JSON-encoded map of module name to the field names to search within that module.

post.summary: Turn a logged-in web (PHPSESSID) session into a webservice session
post.description: Registered by vtigercrm 8.4.0 as a pre-login POST operation. Adopts the browser session named by the PHPSESSID cookie or form field and returns the same session details as login.

PHPSESSID.description: Web session id; read from the PHPSESSID cookie when absent.

get.summary: List the modules related to a module
get.description: Registered by vtigercrm 8.4.0 (660_to_700 migration). Returns the related-list modules of elementType the user can access, with each relation's label.

get.summary: Retrieve a record's related records of one module
get.description: Registered by vtigercrm 8.4.0 (660_to_700 migration). Equivalent to query_related with "SELECT * FROM <relatedType>;".

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Webservice id of the source record, e.g. "11x45".

parameters.name: relatedLabel
parameters.description: Relation label as returned by relatedtypes (needed when two relations link the same modules).

get.summary: Run a VtigerQL query over a record's related records

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: VtigerQL statement over the related module, terminated by a semicolon.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Webservice id of the source record.

parameters.name: relatedLabel
parameters.description: Relation label as returned by relatedtypes.

post.summary: Link records to a source record
post.description: Registered by vtigercrm 8.4.0 (701_to_710 migration).

sourceRecordId.description: Webservice id of the source record.

relatedRecordId.description: Webservice id of the record to link (the handler also accepts an array).

relationIdLabel.description: Relation label, when the modules are related more than once.

get.summary: Retrieve an inventory record with its line items
get.description: Registered by vtigercrm 8.4.0 (540_to_600RC migration). For Invoice, Quotes, SalesOrder and PurchaseOrder: the retrieve result plus a LineItems array.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Webservice id of the inventory record.

get.description: Registered by vtigercrm 8.4.0 (720_to_730 migration). id is "<moduleId>x<attachmentId>"; returns each file with its contents base64-encoded.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Webservice-style id of the attachment, e.g. "15x101".

post.summary: Convert a lead into an account, contact and/or opportunity
post.description: Registered by vtigercrm 8.4.0; its parameter list was corrected to a single JSON-encoded element in 660_to_700. Returns the webservice ids of the records created, keyed by module.
Registered by vtigercrm 8.4.0. Vtiger lower-cases operation names server-side, so changepassword works too.

id.description: Webservice id of the user, e.g. "19x5".

post.summary: Delete a user and transfer their records
post.description: Registered by vtigercrm 8.4.0. Admin only.

id.description: Webservice id of the user to delete.

newOwnerId.description: Webservice id of the user who takes over their records.

OperationGet.name: operation
OperationGet.description: RPC operation name selecting the action performed against /webservice.php.

SessionNameQuery.name: sessionName
SessionNameQuery.description: Active session id returned by login (result.sessionName / sessionId).

token.description: Challenge token to hash with the user access key.

LoginResult.description: Session details returned on successful login.

sessionName.description: Session id used to authenticate subsequent calls.

sessionId.description: Alias of sessionName in some Vtiger versions.

userId.description: Webservice id of the logged-in user, e.g. "19x1".

ModuleType.description: Metadata for a single CRM module (element type).

name.description: Module name, e.g. Contacts. listtypes keys `information` by module name and does not repeat it inside each entry.

isEntity.description: Whether the module represents an entity with records.

ListTypesResult.description: Result of listTypes: accessible module names plus per-module info.

information.description: Map of module name to module metadata.

FieldType.description: Data type descriptor for a module field.

name.description: Field type name, e.g. string, picklist, reference.

refersTo.description: For reference fields, the modules referenced.

Field.description: A single field definition within a module description.

idPrefix.description: Numeric module prefix used in webservice ids.

Element.description: A generic Vtiger CRM record. Field set varies by module; `id` and `assigned_user_id` are common. Additional module fields are permitted.

Contact.description: A record from the Contacts module.

Account.description: A record from the Accounts (organizations) module.

Lead.description: A record from the Leads module.

ElementResponse.description: Envelope for operations that return a single record (create/retrieve/update/revise).

QueryResult.description: Query returns an array of matching records.

updated.description: Records created or updated since modifiedTime.

lastModifiedTime.description: Cursor to pass to the next sync call.

Error.description: Error payload returned when success is false.

MessageResponse.description: Envelope for operations that answer with a message (add_related, changePassword).

RelatedType.description: One relation of a module, keyed by its label in RelatedTypesResult.information.

isEntity.description: vtiger_tab.isentitytype as the database returns it ('1'/'0').

information.description: Map of relation label to relation details.

LineItem.description: One inventory line item (LineItem module record).

File.description: An attached file, as built by vtws_filedetails().

assignedTo.description: Owner of the new records; defaults to the caller.

transferRelatedRecordsTo.description: Module that inherits the lead's related records; defaults to Contacts.

entities.description: Per target module (Accounts, Contacts, Potentials): { create: true, name: <module>, <field>: <value> }.

result.description: Webservice ids of the created records, keyed by module (Accounts, Contacts, Potentials).
Mobile module result; shape varies by operation.
